title: Rangoli
text:
Along with Illumination various halls of residents celebrate Diwali by creating "huge" sand arts colloquially known as Rangoli. Students have developed a lot new creative forms of Rangoli including multi panel Rangolis, Rangolis which show different images depending on the background light and a Rangoli which is gibberish when it is looked at directly but which shows portrait of tagore when looked at through the concave mirror.

 History 

Like Illumination until 2013, three best Rangolis were chosen by the Gymkhana and they were given a pot of Rasogulla.
